title: THES PTA Holiday Market 2026
tagline: Shop local makers, unique gifts, treats, and more — and support Thunder Hill Elementary.
summary: The Thunder Hill Elementary PTA Holiday Market is Saturday, November 21, 2026, 11 AM–3 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School in Columbia, Maryland (Howard County). Shop local makers and small businesses — vendor spaces available now.
flyer_alt: THES PTA Holiday Market 2026 flyer — Saturday, November 21, 2026, 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM at Thunder Hill Elementary School. Vendor registration: $30 early bird until November 1, $40 from November 2 to 18, per 8 by 6 foot space.
about: Join us for a festive day of shopping, community, and small businesses! The THES PTA Holiday Market brings local artisans, crafters, bakers, and small businesses together under one roof — the perfect place to find one-of-a-kind holiday gifts while supporting our school.
Vendor fees go directly to the Thunder Hill Elementary PTA, helping fund programs for our students and teachers.

sections.heading: What You'll Find
items: Handmade and unique gifts from local makers
Baked goods, treats, food, and beverages
Direct-sales favorites and small businesses from our community

sections.heading: Become a Vendor
items: Early bird: $30 per 8' × 6' space, through November 1
Only 40 spaces available — first come, first served
The first 20 vendors to register get a yard sign to advertise the market
You keep 100% of your sales — vendor fees go to the THES PTA
Vendors bring their own tables, chairs, and extension cords (the PTA can't supply these)
sections.note: We're looking for: Artists & artisans, crafters & makers, bakers, food & beverage vendors and food trucks, and direct-sales representatives (Scentsy, Tastefully Simple, Pampered Chef, Tupperware, Nailed It, and more).
